notes.title: v5.161 Frenzy Perk and Random perk machine
notes.content:
REDDOOR Update Version 5.161

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42781929/1fa952d04ab45e432cf3bf87781b7c1b9287c9ae.png[/img]

BUG FIXES:

    Fixed LOD on Low:
        Addressed issues with Level of Detail (LOD) settings on low, improving visual performance and quality for players with lower-end systems.
    REDFALL Trigger Perk Fix:
        Fixed an issue where the trigger perk in the REDFALL area was not functioning correctly.

NEW PERK: FRENZY

    Frenzy Perk:
        Introducing the new Frenzy perk, which grants the player increased melee damage and reach.
        Mow down zombies with ease using this powerful perk.
        The Frenzy perk can be obtained from the random perk machine.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42781929/d1168c2d4c0c575f7a556dd7eb89d892458250bb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42781929/79c5cef25393a2395d4f41196358f66eb3fccc33.png[/img][/url]

NEW FEATURE: RANDOM PERK MACHINE

    Random Perk Machine:
        Added a random perk machine that players can use for 5000 points.
        Test your luck and gain a random perk to aid in your survival.

ANIMATION UPDATES:

    Hand Animations with Pistols and Small Guns:
        Updated animations to include hands when using pistols and small guns, enhancing realism and immersion.
    Knife Animation with a Hand:
        Introduced a new knife animation that includes a hand, providing a more cohesive visual experience.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42781929/520a2fc837efe095b09592399806ee6f7952c6c8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42781929/520a2fc837efe095b09592399806ee6f7952c6c8.png[/img][/url]

    New Weapons in the Mystery Box:
        Added a selection of new weapons to the mystery box.
        Discover and utilize these new additions to enhance your gameplay strategy.

notes.title: REDDOOR Update Version 5.16
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42781929/820605077427685b0189186295bb2688b6181021.png[/img]

NEW MAP: CODENAME ARTEMIS

    Explore the expansive and atmospheric Codename Artemis map.
    Navigate through new and challenging moon base to survive the undead.

NEW FEATURES:

    Misc Settings:
        Auto Aim: Added an option to enable or disable auto aim for easier targeting.
        Glyph Style: Choose between PC or Xbox input glyphs for a customized control display.

STATS:

    Leaderboards:
        All game modes and maps now feature leaderboards.
        Compete with friends and players worldwide to top the charts.

PROGRESSION:

    Item Integration:
        Items are now integrated into your Steam inventory.
        Levels are reset to 1, providing a fresh start for all players.
        As you level up, receive a random skin with over 200+ skins available.

AUDIO UPDATES:

    New MainMenu Music:
        Enjoy a refreshed audio experience with new music for the MainMenu.

GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS:

    Map Geometry Fixes:
        Various fixes to map geometry to improve navigation and eliminate bugs.
    General Bug Fixes:
        Numerous bug fixes to enhance overall game stability and performance.

NEW GAME MODE: CHAOS

    Chaos Mode:
        Start at round 10 with 25,500 points.
        Zombies spawn at twice the usual rate, creating an intense and challenging experience.

VISUAL ENHANCEMENTS:

    New Gore and Blood Effects:
        Enhanced gore and blood effects for a more visceral and immersive experience.

GAME BALANCING:

    Weapon Balancing:
        Adjustments to weapon stats for a more balanced gameplay experience.

NEW ACHIEVEMENTS:

    Achievements:
        New achievements added to reward your progress and accomplishments in the game.

AND MORE . . .


Thank you for playing REDDOOR We hope you enjoy the new features and enhancements in update version 5.16! Your continued support and feedback are invaluable to us.

notes.title: v5.1 UPGRADE STATION AMMO TYPES: REAPER, ELECTRICITY, AND OVERDRIVE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42781929/a113b45437e4efafbf4cb3550513580381a1ef69.png[/img]

We are thrilled to announce that REDDOOR has reached a significant update milestone with version 5.1! Thank you for your continued support and feedback as we strive to deliver the best gaming experience possible.

[h1]UPGRADE STATION AMMO TYPES: REAPER, ELECTRICITY, AND OVERDRIVE:[/h1]

Introducing three new ammo types for the Upgrade Station: Reaper, Electricity, and Overdrive.
Upgrade your weapons with these unique ammo types to unleash devastating effects on zombies.
Experiment with different combinations and strategies to dominate the battlefield.

[h1]FIXED GRENADE LAUNCHER 0 DAMAGE BUG WITH TRIGGER PERK:[/h1]

Resolved an issue where the grenade launcher would sometimes deal no damage when equipped with the Trigger perk.
The grenade launcher will now consistently deal the appropriate damage, providing a more balanced and enjoyable gameplay experience.

[h1]NEW BULLETTRACERS:[/h1]

Enjoy improved visual feedback with the addition of new bullettracers.
Bullets fired from various weapons will now leave behind distinct and dynamic trails, enhancing the immersion and intensity of combat.

[h1]UPGRADE STATION BULLETTRACERS:[/h1]

The Upgrade Station now features its own unique bullettracers.
Witness dazzling effects as you upgrade your weapons and witness their power in action.

Thank you for your support of REDDOOR We hope you enjoy the new features and improvements in this update. Stay tuned for more exciting content in future updates.

- JKFY TEAM

notes.title: v5.08 CODENAME REDFALL EXPANSION, AKIMBO WEAPONS AND MORE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42781929/b570dd7fa7644758e662b41fa42adef8b3ac1bd2.png[/img]
[b]CODENAME REDFALL EXPANSION:[/b]

Explore a new area with unique enemies and challenges
Unlock new weapons and upgrades to take on tougher foes
Discover the secrets of the mysterious REDFALL town
Smaller redfall map renamed to REDFALL RETREAT

[b]ROUND 10 MAP BASED ACHIEVEMENT:[/b]

Reach round 10 on any map to receive a achievement on that map.
Show off your skills and determination to your friends and rivals

[b]SHOOTING IN THE SKY DIDN'T SPAWN BULLETTRACERS FIX:[/b]

Players will now see proper bullettracers when shooting in the sky
This will improve visual feedback and immersion during gameplay

[b]JUMPING ON TOP OF SOUL BOXES WOULD GET YOU STUCK FIX:[/b]

Players will no longer get stuck when jumping on top of soul box

[b]AKIMBO UZI, AKIMBO GLOCK 18, AKIMBO SHORTY:[/b]

Three new dual-wielded weapon options for players to try out
Mix and match with other weapons for unique loadouts and playstyles

[b]CLOUD SAVING FOR LEVEL AND XP:[/b]

Your progress will now be saved to the cloud for easy access across devices
Never lose your hard-earned XP or level advancements again

[b]VSYNC DATA NOW SAVED:[/b]

Players can now save and load their VSync settings
This will improve performance and reduce screen tearing for those with compatible hardware

[b]BLOOM TOGGLE:
[/b]
Players can now toggle bloom on or off in the options menu
This will improve visual customization and player preference options

[b]CRAWLER HITBOX FIXES:[/b]

Hitboxes for crawlers have been adjusted to better match their visual representation
This will improve accuracy and consistency when fighting crawler zombies


[b]Thank you for playing "REDDOOR" and we hope you enjoy this latest update![/b]

- JKFY TEAM

notes.title: v5.079 LINUX AND LEADERBOARDS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42781929/de81393f2a48cd8bb25cc93de8348deebaed8a7f.png[/img]
We're excited to announce a new update to the game, which includes two major additions that we know you've been waiting for. First up, we've added new leaderboards to the game. Now, you can compete against other players for the top spots in various categories, such as highest round. It's a great way to show off your skills and see how you stack up against the rest of the REDDOOR community.

In addition to the new leaderboards, we're also happy to announce that REDDOOR is now available on [b]Linux[/b]! We know that many of you have been asking for this, and we're thrilled to finally be able to offer it to you. Whether you're a long-time Linux user or just starting to explore the world of open-source software, we think you'll love playing REDDOOR on this platform.

As always, we're committed to making REDDOOR the best game it can be, and we're constantly working on new updates and improvements. If you have any feedback or suggestions, please don't hesitate to let us know. We love hearing from our players and we're always looking for ways to make the game even more fun and engaging.

Thank you for playing REDDOOR, and we hope you enjoy the new update!


- JKFY TEAM
